findings: The 1.3.1 source repair is insufficient for the ordinary-ChatGPT startup behavior shown in these tests.
Increasing ordinary-ChatGPT reasoning did not restore the complete welcome in the owner's two reported trials.
Prior conversation context does not explain these two trials because both ordinary-ChatGPT conversations were fresh.
The successful Work report is evidence of a complete introduction and menu in that trial, not proof of byte-exact canonical wording or all-host reliability.
Current saved-plugin source is still 1.3.1 and contains the complete startup excerpt; a saved-source readback does not identify the release or skill content loaded by each active client.

diagnostic_hypotheses: Ordinary ChatGPT did not load the workflow-orchestrator instruction body.
Ordinary ChatGPT loaded an older or incomplete instruction set.
Ordinary ChatGPT loaded the correct body but did not follow its complete-response requirement.

documentation.supported_fact: Skill activation first exposes name and description, then loads complete instructions for matching or direct requests.
documentation.inference_boundary: This makes activation versus instruction-following a useful diagnostic distinction; it does not establish which occurred in these ChatGPT trials.

next_diagnostic.goal: Compare bare invocation with an explicit request to read the existing workflow-orchestrator and copy its canonical startup text in the same ordinary-ChatGPT surface and model.
next_diagnostic.conditions: Fresh conversations, same account, model, reasoning and saved release; explicitly select FrameCore Works Creative Studio through the host @ menu before sending the diagnostic instruction. No creative task or resumed state. The first submitted explicit-request trial omitted that selection and is not a controlled comparison.
next_diagnostic.success_criterion: Actual response text exactly equals assets/startup-welcome.pl.md, allowing only omission of its final file-terminal LF.
next_diagnostic.trace_requirement: Use a real skill-read trace if exposed. Do not treat the assistant's claim that it read a skill as proof.
next_diagnostic.interpretation: Explicit-request success with bare-invocation failure narrows the investigation toward activation or entry routing. Explicit-request failure still requires a real loading trace to distinguish unavailable source from noncompliance.

evidence_boundary: These are ad hoc owner trials and screenshot observations, not agent-executed host runs or completed cases from the 183-case planned evaluation inventory. Source and publication checks remain separate.
